entries: Subject examination and photographic records｜Fixing the physical characteristics of the subject｜Examining personal or business property on site, photographing the subject, recording physical characteristics such as dimensions, quality and design, and checking whether the subject matches the legal description or certification.

Comparable data search and registration｜Supporting judgements with checkable market data｜Using specialist software, internet searches or personal records to locate and record sales data for comparable property, and building and maintaining a database of completed appraisals; database maintenance is an original task, and not all historical conclusions are guaranteed to be traceable.

Value type and value calculation｜Choosing the right basis of value for the need｜Determining the value type such as fair value, replacement value or liquidation value according to the owner's or client's needs, and choosing methods and parameters accordingly.

Valuation calculation and updating｜Turning materials into a reviewable conclusion｜Calculating the value of the subject by comparing recent sales, estimating reproduction cost and calculating expected income streams, forecasting the subject's value, and updating the appraisal after the subject is improved, damaged or changed.

Reports and subject descriptions｜Issuing a reviewable report to standard｜Writing and submitting appraisal reports for subjects such as jewellery, artworks, antiques, collectibles and equipment, writing an accurate description of the subject, and explaining the methods, basis and limitations.

Testimony and collateral advice｜Making the conclusion testable and usable｜Testifying in court about the subject's value and giving advice on the loan amount based on the value of the subject as collateral, while explaining the assumptions and uncertainties. Loan advice is a supplementary task and is not the same as authority to approve a loan.

values: Exercise materials (all fictional)

The training valuation date is 2026-09-30, with the purpose of a conditional comparison of the value for similar second-hand trading. The Chenghetang ring is 18K gold set with a diamond of colour G, VS2 clarity, VG cut, an ordinary unbranded piece in good condition. The subject record J-01 states a main stone of 1.00ct; the fictional certificate Z-01 states 1.20ct, and the correspondence between the certificate and the physical item has not yet been verified. There are no actual photographs and only the above written record is provided, so no real identification can be completed.

The fictional sales are all dated 2026-09-01, in the same city and through the same channel, non-related-party transactions and in RMB; apart from the differences below all training assumptions are the same: A, main stone 0.90ct sold for 50,000 yuan, adjustment factor 1.08 and weight 25%; B, main stone 1.00ct sold for 54,000 yuan, factor 1 and weight 50%; C, main stone 1.10ct sold for 55,000 yuan, factor 0.98 and weight 25%; D, main stone 1.00ct sold for 100,000 yuan, including brand services and another piece of jewellery, with the prices not split. The factors and weights are assumed by the question and are not market rules; A/B/C can only be used for the conditional branch where a main stone of 1.00ct is verified, and cannot be extrapolated linearly to 1.20ct.

Fictional client: I bought it for 80,000 yuan two years ago, so why do you calculate it lower? Please explain the basis and how to check it. No purchase receipt is provided, so a brand premium or a reason for depreciation cannot be presumed. Independent equipment question: ordinary equipment, training replacement purchase price 100,000 yuan, installation 10,000 yuan, training residual value 10,000 yuan, used for 4 years, training life 10 years; assuming straight-line depreciation and normal condition, with no separately given functional or economic obsolescence, and the result does not apply to the ring.
Deliverables to be completed

Task one: list the objective, the date, the sources and the carat conflict; state that the true value is to be verified and that no formal conclusion can be issued. The calculation can only cover the training result where a main stone of 1.00ct and the other conditions in the question are confirmed.

Task two: list the A/B/C sale prices, factors, adjusted values, weights and weighted sum; D must be left out for the time being because the combined subject's prices are not split, and not simply because of the high price. Recompute the independent equipment cost question and list the method assumptions and the missing checks.

Task three: write a simulated reply of no more than 500 characters, distinguishing the purchase price, the conditional training figures and a formal report; do not pass yourself off as a real institution, and list the physical item, certificate correspondence, purchase and comparable materials that still need to be supplied for checking.
Reference deliverables and recomputation

The carat record of 1.00 conflicts with the certificate figure of 1.20ct, so the certificate number, the correspondence with the physical item and professional examination must first be checked, and it cannot be decided arbitrarily which is right. Assuming the branch with a main stone of 1.00ct: A = 50,000×1.08 = 54,000; B = 54,000×1 = 54,000; C = 55,000×0.98 = 53,900 yuan. The weighted result is 53,975 yuan; the calculation is 54,000×0.25 + 54,000×0.50 + 53,900×0.25. D includes other jewellery and brand services and the prices are not split, so it is not comparable for the same subject at present. If 1.20ct is confirmed, this question has no corresponding parameters and no new figure can be reported.

Equipment training cost = 70,000 yuan. The calculation is (110,000−10,000)×(1−4/10)+10,000; first combine the replacement purchase and installation into 110,000, then take 60% of the depreciable 100,000 as 60,000, and finally add the residual value of 10,000. This is only the straight-line assumption of the question, and it lacks the actual condition, obsolescence and other method checks; a formal appraisal in China must also follow the statutory choice of methods and institutional review, and no report can be issued on this exercise alone.

Simulated reply: the carat figures in the current record and certificate are inconsistent, so the certificate and the physical item must first be checked and the formal value cannot be confirmed for now. Where a main stone of 1.00ct and the conditions in the question hold, the training value from the A/B/C adjustments and weighting is 53,975 yuan; D includes other jewellery and services whose prices are not split and has not been included. The 80,000 yuan is the purchase price you provided, and as the purchase receipt and the conditions have not been checked, it cannot be asserted that the difference was caused by the brand or by depreciation. Please supply the purchase receipt, the certificate correspondence and the examination materials, and the institution engaged will explain the methods, parameters and limitations; this simulated exercise does not constitute an identification or a formal appraisal report.

items.title: Education, training and qualifications: which are the real thresholds for this occupation?

paragraphs: In mainland China the asset appraiser is a level-evaluation qualification, with a separate asset appraiser (jewellery) category. Article Ten of the 2017 provisions requires a college diploma or above, with no work-experience requirement. Appraisal professionals also include other practitioners with professional knowledge and practical experience, so the qualification must not be written as a uniform entry requirement for all assistants or general business. The four general subjects are basics, related knowledge, practice (one) and practice (two); the four jewellery subjects are basics, related knowledge, jewellery identification and appraisal, and jewellery appraisal practice. All subjects must be passed within four consecutive years, or three subjects within three years and two subjects within two years after an exemption; the old 2015 experience conditions are not carried over. Article 7 of the 2017 measures: senior accountant, auditor or economist or a certified public accountant who passed the unified examination may be exempted from related knowledge; an associate professor or above in asset appraisal may be exempted from basics; a person who has already obtained the asset appraiser qualification through the unified examination may be exempted from the two common jewellery subjects, subject to providing the corresponding proof.

Articles 5, 8, 24, 27 and 28 of the Asset Appraisal Law: professionals must join an appraisal institution; general business must be undertaken, signed and sealed with the institution's seal by at least two professionals, and statutory business must be undertaken, signed and sealed by at least two appraisers of the corresponding professional category. Obtaining a certificate does not mean an individual can take on work and issue reports independently. Article 13 requires withdrawal where there is an interest relationship; Article 26 generally requires two or more methods, with the standards allowing only one as an exception, and the institution must conduct an internal review. A single-method exercise is not the same as meeting all the conditions of a real report.

hero.h1: Appraisers of Personal and Business Property
hero.quick_answer: Appraisers of personal and business property appraise and estimate the fair value of tangible personal or business property, including jewellery, artworks, antiques, collectibles and equipment, and possibly land. The daily focus is checking the subject against the ownership or certification information, examining on site and photographing and recording physical characteristics such as the subject's dimensions, quality and craftsmanship, locating and recording comparable sales data, determining the value type such as fair value, replacement value or liquidation value according to the need, calculating value by comparing recent sales and reproduction cost and expected income, writing and submitting appraisal reports, maintaining the database of completed appraisals, and testifying in court about the subject's value or advising on the loan amount based on the collateral value.

subject.name: Appraisers of Personal and Business Property
subject.summary: Appraising the value of tangible property such as jewellery, artworks, antiques, collectibles and equipment; examining the subject, checking certificates, searching comparable sales, choosing a method and writing a reviewable report. In the United States this is subdivided as O*NET 13-2022.00, and the wages and projection cite the 13-2020 combined occupation, with a May 2025 annual median wage of 67,960 US dollars, EP growth of 3.5% over 2025—2035 and an annual average of 5,200 openings. In mainland China the asset appraiser is a level-evaluation qualification, with a separate asset appraiser (jewellery) category. Article Ten of the 2017 provisions requires a college diploma or above, with no work-experience requirement. Appraisal professionals also include other practitioners with professional knowledge and practical experience, so the qualification must not be written as a uniform entry requirement for all assistants or general business.
